title: DevOps & Platform
description: Let agents write infrastructure and run automation without surprises: policies as prompts, small verifiable rollouts, and hard guardrails around anything destructive.

nodes.title: Policy as prompt
nodes.summary: Your platform's security and reliability rules (pinned versions, non-root containers, resource limits, health checks) are exactly the constraints an agent needs. Put them in the prompt or rules file as a checklist the output can be verified against.
points: Phrase every rule so a scanner or reviewer can check it.
Include the reason for non-obvious rules; models follow reasons better.
Ask the agent to check its output against the list before answering.
Back the prompt with real policy checks in CI.

sections.title: Automation
sections.description: Plan the rollout, gate the risk.

sections.title: Operate
sections.description: Review changes and limit blast radius.

nodes.title: Least privilege for agents
nodes.summary: An agent should have only the permissions its task needs: read-only by default, scoped credentials, and no production access without approval. Prompts set intent; permissions enforce it.
points: Start agents read-only and grant write access per task.
Require approval for production changes and anything irreversible.
Never paste secrets into prompts; reference them through the environment.
